messages:
Hannah Ortiz: Quick fun idea 1st-century sandwich roulette + boardgame night next Wednesday in the common area? bring one pre-made wrapped sandwich (label ingredients) and we swap randomly. 9c635e
Marcus Flynn: omg yes. do we do a raffle to pick sandwiches or blind trade?
Hannah Ortiz: blind trade using numbers! everyone gets a slip, draw at 7pm.
Priya Desai: can we do two categories: savory and sweet (for dessert sandwiches)?
Ethan Wu: savory/sweet split sounds good. also i can provide a folding table and napkins.
Sofia Alvarez: ill bring a vegan chickpea salad sammie and the game Codenames.
Noah Kim: ill bring some mini bottles for mocktails + a tiny sign that says "mocktail station". DesignBot: FYI: event poster template uploaded to #design-reqs if you want a quick printable.
Ava Thompson: count me in. suggest a 6:30 start, food swap at 7, games after?
Hannah Ortiz: plan: doors open 6:30, sandwich drop + mingle, swap at 7, games 7:15-9:15.
Marcus Flynn: RSVP quick reaction: :raised_hands: = in, :x: = out, :wave: = maybe.
Priya Desai: 44d
Ethan Wu: 44d
Sofia Alvarez: 44d
Noah Kim: 44d
Ava Thompson: 44d
Hannah Ortiz: logistics: please label major allergens (eggs, dairy, nuts, sesame). if youre bringing meat, note it.
Priya Desai: can someone bring extra wax paper? my wraps are messy.
Marcus Flynn: i have a roll, dropping it off.
DesignBot: Printable table labels created: SAVORY / SWEET / VEGAN / NUTS / CONTAINS DAIRY.
Hannah Ortiz: also mini challenge: whoever gets the "mystery golden toothpick" sandwich gets to pick the first game. :trophy:
Ethan Wu: love that. i'll make one sandwich with a decorative toothpick. low-risk.
Sofia Alvarez: game request: Betrayal at House on the Hill? long but fun.
Noah Kim: maybe keep a couple of shorter games too: Sushi Go!, Love Letter, Codenames.
Ava Thompson: rooftop moves if its clear? better airflow.
Hannah Ortiz: good call 321 if weather is nice well move to rooftop. backup is common area.
Marcus Flynn: parking question: will guests (plus-ones) need visitor passes?
Hannah Ortiz: yes please sign guest names on the sheet at front desk.
Priya Desai: small accessibility note: please keep one low table area for folks who prefer quieter seating.
Hannah Ortiz: noted, will reserve a quieter corner. thank you!
Ava Thompson: sleepy delivery alert: anyone want me to bring oat milk? im making a latte run at 6:15.
Noah Kim: yes please oat milk!
Marcus Flynn: ill bring extra plates and some toothpicks in case we run out.
Hannah Ortiz: RSVP count so far: Hannah, Marcus, Priya, Ethan, Sofia, Noah, Ava = 7. cap at 24.
Priya Desai: anyone allergic to sesame? putting it on my plate just in case.
Ethan Wu: not me.
DesignBot: Reminder: "Mystery Sandwich & Boardgames" poster printed and taped to lounge door today.
Hannah Ortiz: thanks everyone 60a see you Wednesday! drop song recs for the swap playlist below if you want.
Marcus Flynn: Rec: A Tribe Called Quest 3b5
Sofia Alvarez: Rec: Santana 3b8
Priya Desai: Rec: Janelle Mone1e 3b6
Hannah Ortiz: perfect mix 44f
